description: This source file defines the AppointmentService class which provides methods to perform CRUD operations and queries related to appointments, interfacing with the Supabase backend. It encapsulates appointment-related functionalities in a healthcare application.

classes.name: AppointmentService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to manage appointment data within a healthcare Flutter application, interacting with a Supabase backend.

methods.name: listForPatient
methods.description: Retrieves a list of appointments for a specific patient based on patient ID.

methods.name: listForDoctor
methods.description: Retrieves a list of appointments for a specific doctor based on doctor ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a single appointment by its unique ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new appointment record in the database.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Sets the status of an appointment to 'cancelled' based on appointment ID.
